name: unraid-ops
description: Unraid server administration: parity array, pools, shares, Docker, VMs, remote access, performance and failure recovery — with a guard against the documented data-loss command patterns and read-only access to the Unraid GraphQL API.

api_url.title: Unraid GraphQL endpoint
api_url.description: Full URL to the API, e.g. http://tower.local/graphql

api_key.title: Unraid API key
api_key.description: Create on the server with: unraid-api apikey --create --name claude -r admin

allow_mutations.title: Allow GraphQL mutations
allow_mutations.description: Off by default. Mutations can start and stop the array and control containers and VMs.

insecure_tls.title: Skip TLS verification
insecure_tls.description: Enable only for a server using a self-signed certificate on a trusted LAN.
